title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Riverside Orthopedic Associates under your health plan for services provided on August 20, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Your plan has reached its annual benefit limit for this type of service, so this claim is not covered. Reason code: CO-96.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $14,364.79 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $14,364.79.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: Your written appeal must be received by March 7, 2027. Send it to Brightmoor Benefit Solutions, Appeals Unit, PO Box 78594, Orlando, FL 32801. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-1961.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
